faq_default_1_q: What is the minimum sponsorship amount?
faq_default_1_a: The minimum sponsorship amount is $30 per month, which covers tuition, books, uniforms, daily meals, and basic healthcare for a child.
faq_default_2_a: 100% of your donation goes directly to programs. 70% covers children's education and welfare, 20% supports teachers and staff, and 10% goes to facilities and operations.
faq_default_3_q: Can I choose which child to sponsor?
faq_default_3_a: Yes! You can browse profiles of children waiting for sponsors and choose a child whose story resonates with you. We'll connect you with your sponsored child.
faq_default_4_q: How will I receive updates about my sponsored child?
faq_default_4_a: You'll receive regular updates including progress reports, photos, and letters from your sponsored child. You can also exchange messages and build a meaningful connection.
faq_default_5_a: Yes. All donations are tax-deductible. You will receive an official receipt via email immediately after donation, and annual consolidated receipts are provided for tax purposes.
about_fallback_mission: Our mission is to provide quality education and holistic development opportunities to underprivileged children, empowering them to break the cycle of poverty and become self-reliant, contributing members of society.
about_fallback_vision: We envision a world where every child, regardless of their background, has access to quality education and the opportunity to realize their full potential.
about_fallback_description: Buddha Academy was founded with a simple yet powerful belief: education is the most effective tool to transform lives. Located in a community where many families struggle to afford basic education, we provide comprehensive support including tuition, books, uniforms, meals, and healthcare to ensure every child can learn and thrive.
about_value_compassion_desc: We treat every child with kindness, understanding, and respect, fostering a nurturing environment.
about_value_excellence_desc: We strive for the highest standards in education, character development, and community service.
about_value_integrity_desc: We operate with complete transparency, ensuring every donation is used effectively and ethically.
about_value_empowerment_desc: We believe in empowering children through education to break the cycle of poverty.
about_timeline_1_desc: Buddha Academy was established with the vision to provide quality education to underprivileged children in the community.
about_timeline_2_desc: Celebrated the graduation of our first cohort of students, marking a significant milestone in our journey.
about_timeline_3_desc: Expanded facilities to accommodate more students, adding new classrooms, a library, and computer lab.
about_timeline_4_desc: Introduced the child sponsorship program, connecting donors directly with students to fund their education.
about_timeline_5_desc: Adapted to remote learning during global challenges, providing tablets and internet access to all students.
about_timeline_6_desc: Reached over 250 enrolled students with 180+ active sponsors supporting their educational journey.
about_timeline_7_desc: Recognized for outstanding contribution to community education and child welfare development.
sponsorship_hero_subtitle: For just NPR 5,000 per month, you can transform a child's life through the power of education at Buddha Academy in Kathmandu.
